course_name_original: ATATURK'S PRINCIPLES & HISTORY OF TURKISH REFORMS II
course_name_en: ATATURK'S PRINCIPLES & HISTORY OF TURKISH REFORMS II

learning_outcomes.text: To instill national and patriotic love in university youth, ensuring they are raised as Atatürkist youth committed to Atatürk's principles.
To develop their democratic awareness and help them understand the stages through which we reached the contemporary democratic administration level.
To equip Turkish youth with the attitude, behavior, and ability to propose solutions to current and future problems with an Atatürkist approach.
